description.subtitle: Argentina national team adidas anthem tracksuit jacket for the 2026 away kit - black
description.tagline: History of Argentine football with Originals essence
description.intro: The adidas Originals Argentina Anthem Jacket is much more than a sports garment: it is a tribute to the culture and heritage of Argentine football, reinterpreted for today's lifestyle. It combines a retro aesthetic with a modern approach, reflecting the spirit of the game and its timeless appeal.
key_benefits: Historical inspiration: Design based on Argentina's away kit.
Doubleknit fabric: Comfortable and resistant structure with premium finish.
Regular fit: Balanced fit for everyday wear.
Full Zipper: Easy on and off, secure fit.
Trefoil logo and AFA shield: Originals identity with football DNA.
